newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.48 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 102.61660 UDIs and a real return of 6.48 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday, dealers said.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 6.77 percent with a price of 101.88852 UDIs.
Demand this week was 2.38 billion UDIs compared to 500 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.76.
Two weeks ago demand was 1.15 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.88.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MXAAN.
